- [USER] User mentioned "Apkallu."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Apkallu, or the Seven Sages of Sumer, are described as legendary beings from ancient Mesopotamian mythology, meaning "wise men" or "sages."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Apkallu were sent by the gods to teach humans various skills and crafts, depicted as half-human, half-fish creatures.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Apkallu were believed to communicate with the gods and were revered for their wisdom and knowledge.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Apkallu myth is noted for its lasting impact on Mesopotamian culture, symbolizing the wisdom and knowledge humans seek.
